units.summary: Adds a function type that builds a restricted BlockReader over a head slice [mint, maxt]. It is only a type declaration; behavior lives in compactHeadViewLocked and its callers, which are reviewed separately.
units.headline: New headViewFactory function type for restricted head views
units.reason: A bare function type declaration has no runtime effect itself; the logic using it is in compactHeadViewLocked.

units.summary: Adds a function type for evicting just-compacted series from the head, with a documented contract about the maxt and appendID watermark. The type adds no behavior; the eviction implementations are in head.go and are reviewed separately.
units.headline: New headSeriesEvictor function type with eviction contract
units.reason: A type declaration with a doc comment has no runtime effect; the eviction logic is in the truncate functions.
